item.title: Show HN: Skaylar – Analyze Datasets with Benford's Law
item.summary: Skaylar is an open source tool for analyzing and visualizing first-digit distributions in a dataset using Benford's Law. Users can manually input/paste data or upload JSON dataset files and analyze them. The results are shown in a table and a graph of the actual and expected curves is plotted.
